name: search_website
description: Search DuckDuckGo (4-6 core terms; pass auto_open_top=1 or 'open: <query>' to auto-open top authoritative primary URL in 1 call), fetch an http(s) webpage/PDF/catalog as Markdown (pass filter_query or inline 'https://... <keywords>' on long pages/PDFs for <=10 KB; include_code=False default), or run up to 10 items via queries_or_urls=[...] (or 'q1 || q2') with SQLite WAL caching, <=9.5 KB slack-redistributed batch budget, and URL deduplication. MANDATORY BEFORE SEARCHING: check whether ./docs/index.md has '## Search keywords' (via compress_context(file_path='docs/index.md', section='Search keywords')). If present and in the project's domain, include 1-3 fitting keywords from '## Search keywords' in every query (1-2 leading vision/scale priority terms for project architecture/UI/scale/workflow queries, or 1-2 technical/methodological terms like primary-source-verification, ISO-NEN-IEC, IETF-RFC, NIST-SP-800, OWASP-ASVS, Python-stdlib for external protocol/RFC/standard/scientific queries instead of abstract vision words like zero-trust; never 0 keywords). Outside the project's domain, search without project keywords.

auto_open_top.description: Number of top authoritative primary URLs (0-3) to auto-open and filter after a DuckDuckGo search (or prefix 'open: ').

filter_query.description: Keyword filter for http(s) URLs (or inline 'https://... <keywords>'). Pass by default on long pages, catalogs or PDFs (<10 KB) to filter items/sections by matching terms, with 'site:<domain>' fallback on 0 matches.

include_code.description: Keep multi-line code blocks (<pre>, ```) when fetching an http(s) URL (default False keeps inline <code> only).

queries_or_urls.description: Optional batch list of up to 10 search queries or http(s) URLs executed in one call with shared SQLite WAL cache and URL deduplication.

query_or_url.description: Search query (4-6 core terms, or 'open: <query>' to auto-open top primary URL), http(s) URL, 'https://... <keywords>', or ' || '-separated items. Follow the '## Search keywords' rule when ./docs/index.md exists.
